outcome: quality of information on external cephalic version (ECV) on YouTube
usefulness of information on ECV on YouTube
presence of misinformation on ECV on YouTube
finding: Only a small percentage of YouTube videos about ECV are considered useful, and those with higher audience engagement had a lower usefulness score.
mod_finding: This study focuses on external cephalic version (ECV) as a method to prevent breech presentation and potentially reduce the need for cesarean deliveries, but does not directly compare modes of delivery.
